nameOrigin.text: Investors from Holland bought the Caribou Mill in 1873 and renamed the town Nederland, which means lowland; it sits on lower ground than Caribou.

founded.text: Began as a huddle of cabins called Dayton

timeline.text: The town began as a huddle of cabins called Dayton, later known as Brown's Crossing.
Investors from Holland bought the Caribou Mill and the town took the name Nederland.
Nederland resident Scott Harrison trucked the empty frame of a Looff carousel from Utah to Nederland and began carving animals for it.
The Carousel of Happiness opened on Memorial Day.
Boulder County bought the artifact collection of the Nederland Mining Museum, which the Nederland Area Historical Society had created and run.

sites.name: Carousel of Happiness
sites.hours: Days and times vary by season: generally 7 days a week from Memorial Day through Labor Day, weekends the rest of the year
sites.cost: $3 per ride; infants younger than 9 months ride free
